question: As part of a stakeholder analysis, the users of the organization’s services have been identified as stakeholders. These users rely on managers to agree requirements and are happy with the services they receive. Which communication strategy should MOST LIKELY be used for these stakeholders? A. Manage closely B. Keep informed C. Keep satisfied D. Monitor

A stakeholder in a project to create a new mobile app is categorized as high influence and low interest. Which is the BEST approach to communicating with the stakeholder? A. Agree a method of communication that satisfies the stakeholder’s needs B. Monitor the stakeholder monthly to check if their level of interest in the project has changed C. Ensure that the stakeholder is informed about any important project changes D. Keep the stakeholder closely involved in all project issues
